exam_scheme.note: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) conducts selection for teaching posts (PGTs and TGTs) through a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a Personal Interview. For PGTs, the CBT comprises 150 questions (180 minutes duration) across six parts: Part I General Awareness (10 Qs, 10 marks), Part II Reasoning Ability (20 Qs, 20 marks), Part III Knowledge of ICT (10 Qs, 10 marks), Part IV Teaching Aptitude (10 Qs, 10 marks), Part V Domain Knowledge & NEP 2020 pedagogy (80 Qs, 80 marks), and Part VI Language Competency Test (20 Qs, 20 marks: General English 10, General Hindi 10). Part VI is strictly qualifying (minimum 40% marks in each language is mandatory to have Parts I-V evaluated). For TGTs, total test length is 150 questions (120 marks evaluated + 30 marks Language Competency across Regional Language, English, and Hindi). Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies for each wrong answer in CBT. Final merit gives 80% weightage to CBT and 20% weightage to Interview.

papers.negative_marking: -0.25 marks for each incorrect response (1/4th negative marking)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Included in Stage 1 merit evaluation (130 marks for PGT / 120 marks for TGT)

papers.paper_name: Part V: Domain Specific Subject Knowledge & Experiential Pedagogy (NEP 2020)
Part VI: Language Competency Test (General English & General Hindi / Regional Language)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory 40% minimum qualifying marks in each language separately; non-qualifiers are disqualified from CBT ranking

stages.source_label: NVS Recruitment Scheme — Interview & Final Merit Computation

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview (Subject Knowledge, Communication Skills, Teaching Aptitude)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Weighted at 20% in the composite selection score (80% CBT + 20% Interview)

financial_package.note: NVS is an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Teachers and officers are remunerated per the central 7th Central Pay Commission (7th CPC) Pay Matrix.
financial_package.pay_source_label: NVS Detailed Recruitment Notification 2022–23 — Pay Matrix Level 8 (₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100) for Post Graduate Teachers
financial_package.estimate_note: Spans entry TGT at Level 7 basic ₹44,900 (gross ~₹75,000, in-hand ~₹67,000) to PGT at Level 8 basic ₹47,600 (basic ₹47,600 + 58% DA ₹27,608 + 10% Special Allowance for residential duties ₹4,760 + central HRA/quarters + transport allowance = gross ~₹96,000, in-hand ~₹88,000 after 10% NPS deduction).
official_perks: Mandatory rent-free furnished/unfurnished residential accommodation inside Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNV) residential school campus
Free boarding and meals in school dining mess during session duties
Special Allowance of 10% of basic pay for arduous residential school responsibilities
Medical facilities / reimbursement as per Central Services (Medical Attendance) CS(MA) Rules / CGHS
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child and free schooling in JNVs for wards of NVS employees
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution by Government of India
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Home Town Concession entitlements
Full salary coverage during seasonal school vacations (Summer, Autumn, and Winter breaks)
